Name: Mellow Yellow Interior Rhinebeck Edition
Author: qtangpow
Description:
Hello!

As stated in the overview, the interior textures were changed with a color palette inspired by the Rhinebeck series in the Hudson Valley Buildings mod by magimatica. You can find said mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1478]here.[/url]

Interior textures include:
[list]
[*]The border of most building's interiors
[*]Pillars (i.e like the ones found in Robin's house)
[*]Stairs
[*]Hallway walls inside the farm
[*]Kitchen cabinets and countertops
[/list]
Additions found in Rhinebeck 2:
[list]
[*]Fixed a graphical issue in Alex's House
[*]Made more of the walls of town buildings whiter (see Alex's house for reference)
[/list]
You will need SMAPI and Content Patcher for this mod to work.

Special thanks goes to my fiance and Pathoschild for helping me figure out the coding :)

Downloads.Description: Makes the interior of the house white and blue, as well as add white accents to the rest of the town.
